title: Context-Adaptive Runtime Systems for Mobile Neural Networks
abstract: In this work, we propose a novel framework for context-adaptive runtime systems for mobile neural networks designed specifically for resource-constrained mobile and edge environments. Comprehensive benchmarks illustrate superior performance across both synthetic workloads and standard edge benchmarks.

title: Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling for Neural Processing Units
abstract: Mobile AI deployment is severely hindered by energy consumption, thermal saturation, and strict memory budgets. title: Latency-Critical Mobile Vision Processing on Heterogeneous SoCs

We devise an adaptive runtime decision mechanism that monitors hardware telemetry in real time and automatically reconfigures computation graphs. title: Memory Footprint Optimization in Embedded Natural Language Models

We validate the runtime implementation on diverse commercial SoCs under fluctuating thermal and battery levels.
